text:
Aya (Content): Quick proposal: run a 10-day mini-launch for an OSS refkit + three bite-sized how-tos + a short benchmark writeup. Objective: get community traction and a small pool of webinar leads. Thoughts?
Ruben (DevRel): I can own the refkit repo and the reproducible perf harness. Plan: mono-repo with /examples/quickstart, /examples/embeddings, /examples/cost-tune. Will add CONTRIBUTING and a tiny badge for contributors.
Kira (Growth): Routing plan: Typeform (email-only) -> Zapier catch -> HubSpot. UTM pattern suggestion: utm_source=community&utm_medium=refkit&utm_campaign=mini_launch_mar2026. Keep gating light.
Marta (Design): I can produce a hero image + three tutorial thumbnails + a short GIF showing batching impact. Need final hero copy by Tuesday EOD.
Leo (Ops): I'll set up the Zapier catch hook in staging and run a webhook smoke test. Recommend adding a Honeypot hidden field on the Typeform to reduce spam.
Aya (Content): Proposed tutorial topics: 1) Quickstart text gen (streaming example), 2) Embeddings for similarity search, 3) Cost/perf tuning (batching + prefix cache). Each should be 400-600 words + a runnable snippet and a <12 min screencap.
Ruben (DevRel): For reproducibility I'll include a Dockerfile and a small script: `python harness.py --runs 10 --out results.csv`. CSV columns: run, model, seq_len, batch, median_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, est_cost_usd.
Kira (Growth): CTA variants for A/B: "Try the RefKit" vs "Preview the Demo". I'll run for 72 hours after launch. Also will add hidden field ambassador=true if someone came from partner list.
Marta (Design): Tone: straightforward, slightly playful microcopy. Will post three hero variants.
Leo (Ops): Zapier staging curl (for QA):
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/88888/mock -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"qa+refkit@redwood.com","utm_campaign":"mini_launch_mar2026"}'
```
CommunityBot: Zap created (staging) -> Typeform catch endpoint 88888. Status: ready.
Aya (Content): Benchmark story brief: 500-700 words. Compare baseline (no batching) vs tuned (batch=8, kv-cache enabled, q4 quant) with one recommended config and an actionable table. Include two charts: latency CDF and cost per 1k tokens.
Ruben (DevRel): I'll commit initial scaffold to GH private repo and flip public at launch. CLI starter command: `npx redwood-refkit init --example mini-launch`.
Kira (Growth): Lead nurture: immediate thank-you + quickstart, day 3 benchmark highlight, day 7 invite to 20-min live walkthrough. I'll wire automated emails and tracking.
Marta (Design): Uploaded first drafts to #marketing-assets. Feedback welcome.
Leo (Ops): Checklist for launch readiness: webhook test green, landing page live, repo public, assets uploaded, SRE signoff for the demo. I'll run the readiness check 24h before launch.
Aya (Content): Owners recap: Refkit & harness: @Ruben; Tutorials & benchmark: @Aya; Routing & nurture: @Kira; Graphics: @Marta; Zap + readiness: @Leo. Target launch in ~10 days.
Ruben (DevRel): noted. Adding CONTRIBUTING, badge generator, and a tiny benchmark runner today.
Kira (Growth): I'll add UTM macros to the shared sheet and set up A/B test. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/refkit-mini (internal).
CommunityBot: Reminder scheduled: mini-launch sync in 4 days at 11:00 AM.
Aya (Content): Thanks team — I'll drop the sprint checklist tomorrow and tag any blockers. :rocket:
